---
title: "QoL death-inclusive Markov — model fitting"
subtitle: "First-order ordinal transition models for 50 completed datasets"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

A Bayesian first-order ordinal transition model is fitted to each independently
completed longitudinal dataset. Death is state 8 and absorbing. The model uses
the imputed previous state; the partial proportional-odds term permits the time
effect to differ across outcome cut-points. The formula is never simplified
automatically.

```{r}
#| label: fit-death-inclusive-longitudinal-qol
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$main$m)
output_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "qol-death-inclusive-longitudinal"
)
imputation_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "imputations")
model_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "models")
diagnostic_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(diagnostic_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pcontrast_tx <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.5
)
model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev +
  ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis_code + cluster(id)

for (index in indices) {
  data_path <- file.path(
    imputation_dir,
    sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  diagnostic_path <- file.path(
    diagnostic_dir,
    sprintf("diagnostics-%02d.parquet", index)
  )
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path) && file.exists(diagnostic_path)) next

  data <- arrow::read_parquet(data_path) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      y = as.integer(as.character(y)),
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:7),
      ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE)
    )
  dd <- rms::datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")
  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index, offset = 500L)

  model <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
    formula = model_formula,
    pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
    ppo = ~week,
    cppo = function(y) y,
    data = data,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = config$markov$iterations,
    warmup = config$markov$warmup,
    refresh = 0L,
    backend = "cmdstan",
    loo = FALSE,
    sampling.args = list(
      seed = fit_seed,
      parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
    )
  )
  diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)

  if (!isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    model <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
      ppo = ~week,
      cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)
  }
  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  diagnostic_output <- as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary) |>
    mutate(
      imputation = index,
      divergent_transitions = diagnostics$divergent_transitions,
      treedepth_exceeded = diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded,
      min_bfmi = diagnostics$min_bfmi
    )
  arrow::write_parquet(
    diagnostic_output,
    diagnostic_path,
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}

options(datadist = NULL)
```
